page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred title block of lines in several sizes and type faces, with an engraved ornament (two winged putti holding a laurel wreath) below the text, then the printer's imprint and date at the foot. No marginal notes, running head, page number or catchword.
page.notes: The woodcut ornament between "solitis." and the imprint is an engraving, not text, and is not transcribed. Excluded as not printed text: the handwritten "6" at top right, the library shelf mark "A-6027-046" and the library stamp below the imprint. "locoq;" is copied as printed (loco with abbreviated que); the mark after "loco" is faint and may be read differently.
